body:

Hi, it’s Charles Booker, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky
against Rand Paul.

My opponent was so afraid to debate me that he refused to show up:

clean_body: | Friend, I'm reaching out because we're at the point of the campaign where we're not operating in terms of weeks or days but hours. Right now, our campaign doesn't have the resources to keep up the momentum we'd gained in Ohio. We were making our way back in the polls, we were catching up to Tim Ryan's war chest, and we were pushing back against all the attack ads being run against me, but then our fundraising just seemed to STOP. I don't know if we have the resources to get through the next 48 HOURS if we don't get emergency support NOW. We've done so much in the past year to turn our country around. We can't just lay down and quit. We've got to stand up and fight back before we run out of time. That's why I'm humbly asking you to contribute something to our campaign today, even if you already have, to save our chances of winning come November 8th. If MAGA Republicans have their way, contraception and marriage equality, the whole right to privacy, could be at risk. If Sen. Rick Scott has his way, every five years, Congress would have to vote to change, cut, reduce, or entirely eliminate Social Security -- and if they do nothing, it goes out of existence. But it doesn’t have to go their way: If we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, Derek, we will codify Roe. If we support Democrats, Social Security can be protected. If you’ve been waiting on the sidelines looking for the best time to donate, this is it. Make a $7 donation to the DNC today. There are only 18 days left. America is at an inflection point. America has to choose: Are we going to move forward or backward? Are we going to build the future or obsess about the past? Together, we can choose a different path -- forward to a future of unity and hope and some optimism -- and choose to build a better America. Thanks for being on this team, Derek. Joe Joseph R. subject: 🚨 IN-01 Polling Locations are Short-Staffed. We Need Your Help!
body:
We still need 60 Republicans to serve as poll workers in precincts throughout Lake County – particularly in heavily Democrat
areas.

Jennifer-Ruth Green for Congress [http://email.email.jennifer-ruth.com/c/eJxtkE1rwzAMhn9NfVuQv52DDz20tDAGo2yFXYrjr3pzEi_OKP33S3rZZSAhwSu9PJK9JKf3h-3xXndfpxN_fSmGDsd8Rnm0q-af7eEjHL_JLZ7Zfbqp7u0d-d6kfJnvxWtr-mJSHFDSBAjBSwJlktMGeBAdhNBh1UmqyIbBY6_59MOQgp-epp_52tixR1cNDBgzAWMMrWsxts52hHPHmXdUKoayvs5zqRu63ZD9EnUeJxN9E8cxZm9KqqvTIvQ11sFNS_cf-jrgXTJLFaSjCig3jAuliPWttC0JpilDRJN25ZZyTlXIBTw-wFfUv9PX7wjKKZdeWakkCUAAnFTCO-Q1FkIwDEwy5LSCDoj7BbZ4ci4]

The poll workers that staff Lake County Elections are required by law to be a mix of Republicans and Democrats ...unless one party
cannot provide a sufficient number of poll workers. In that case, there won’t be Republican eyes in the room. It is important to
be certain we have Republicans at every polling location to help process the election and to watch for and report any shenanigans.

We still need 60 Republicans to serve as poll workers in precincts throughout Lake County – particularly in heavily Democrat
areas.

If we don’t have a Republican worker in each polling location, the rules could go out the window and the door is open to election
shenanigans.

...we'd have no way of knowing if the rules are being followed.

To help ensure the results are fair for Jennifer-Ruth, we need your help! [http://email.email.jennifer-ruth.com/c/eJxFT01LxDAU_DXNzZKvJvGQwx5ctyKCLrrgZcnHSxtN29h2LfvvbfcizMCDYWbeuHP0en_Y1dfp4ft4rF5fsmF9nU4oDW7T4NkdPkP9Q5fmxK_jouz7B4LOxHSerxm0M102selR1BRTSlZixmXFSlwFYXEIligrmaIFxzdf-QV9HwOMd-Nlbks3dKjV0nFPjbU8BGYcEEoMte6eOMZ4AOlQ0u0856lgu4LuVzy9PZbNkNfrd0iXfgYY0ah9XmJKcRJybWtubVv-_7_bJMEqVklQTipJA6YYe6kEeASaCCE4wVxy5LXCFlP_B46TW14]

What do poll workers do?

Poll workers process the voters, on a precinct level, on Election Day. There are three main roles: (1) Inspector, (2) Judge, and
(3) Clerk.

Inspector - Picks up election supplies, oversees the precinct, administers the oath, returns supplies.

Judge - Assists the inspector in making decisions, sets up and provides instructions to all voters on how to use the voting
machines.

Clerk - Asks voters to provide photo ID and processes voters on the PollPad

Who can be a poll worker?

Poll workers are nominated by the county chairpersons of the two major political parties. Poll workers must be voters of the
county. Students, 16 or 17 years of age, may serve as poll workers with a completed student form and permission signatures. Please
refer to the Election Day handbook for further qualifications.

Can I leave the poll location on Election Day?

No. Poll Workers must remain in the polling location for the day. Please make arrangements for your meals and whatever you may
need for the entire day.

How much do poll workers get paid and when do I get paid?

• Judges $175 (Additional $25 if the Republican judge returns the equipment with the Inspector)

• Clerks $175

Poll worker paychecks are processed by the Auditor's office and are generally delivered via USPS six weeks after the election.

Poll workers are the front line defenders of the electoral process on Election Day. This is one of the most important jobs during
the election and quite simply, we cannot ensure a fair election without sufficient numbers of Republican election workers.

Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq4qv5spm0cj3rsebo0lqv76fq54q0dfgslq06qo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64o72c5h2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsq3d73kc6m9u4ir9h9a6k4pietaf8fios269hv8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64o72c5h2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv07118smt01p3pakoqe3as32b6ao7et2e198uk8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64o72c5h2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

| | My fellow American, Before I was running against him to be the next Governor of Nevada, Steve Sisolak said I was the best Sheriff in America and the best one that my county could ever ask for. Now that I’m running against him? Sisolak is attacking both my record AND the men and women who bravely serve in law enforcement alongside me... In a minute, I’ll tell you more about why I decided to run against this corrupt Governor in the first place and finally take back the state of Nevada. **But first, since this critical election is just WEEKS away – and early voting is about to start up this weekend – [will you send in immediate support to help my team contact voters so we can FIRE Gavin Newsom-ally and Joe Biden-supporter Steve Sisolak? >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbfhfbv151eppalge1pr08pk8rba5lnbt65a08pg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64p72cph2bs)**

---
| Here are _**just 3 of many big reasons why this failed Governor has GOT to go...**_ **CRIME:** Steve Sisolak’s radical, anti-police policies have lessened penalties for crime, enabled career criminals including **FENTANYL** dealers, and removed the police’s ability to make arrests. Getting tough on crime with law enforcement leadership is about keeping our daughters safe – something that Sisolak is refusing to do by putting criminals first. But I have over 30 years of experience in law enforcement – and I’m ready to put it to work protecting our communities. [Help Me Fire Sisolak >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zt0cngle0quued7homklrvh14eq4ib6pad58c0mg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64p72cph2bs) **THE ECONOMY:** It’s not a secret that inflation is through the roof right now... But Steve Sisolak couldn’t care less. While countless Nevadans and Americans are worried about things like housing payments right now, don’t count Sisolak in that camp. He’s never had to worry about paying a mortgage or making rent – he became a multi-millionaire when he **sued Nevada taxpayers for $23,500,000! ** Maybe that’s why he saw nothing wrong with praising the very same Biden spending policies that economists AGREE added fuel to this inflation fire. [Help Me Fire Sisolak >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbsnosge3m6pcjrrtv5mo3tfgvui1tf1g6nsdk10_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64p72cph2bs) **CORRUPTION:** Finally, the reason why they call him Northshore Steve... While he was closing over 95,000 Nevada small businesses for GOOD, Steve Sisolak was also doling out nine-figure government contracts for COVID tests to a company with major campaign donor connections. Turns out – they didn’t work! And he tried to hide this from us, all while lives were on the line! It’s part of a MAJOR pattern of pay-to-play corruption. And it’s why Steve Sisolak belongs nowhere near the Nevada Governor’s Office. [Help Me Fire Sisolak >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zht5r3rb4avld5t19nv0rsfrb1458u1r2imoec7o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j64p72cph2bs)

This is my story

| |
---
| | | Hi, I’m Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47044%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vREmiLd5jxx0vNsmETB2KQ&sysid=1 "Adam 1")
---

I didn’t know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I’ll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47155%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8RIuXOfLSNbOQpHZRnIwfQ&sysid=1 "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn’t always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could’ve accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47156%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q9HGT0tbLaIVDhDgJ9l6Qg&sysid=1 "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47157%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IV%2f5zWqu0tx6J3zu%2fdvYlg&sysid=1 "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn’t done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada’s Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47158%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uba1F0tr0HbWctqTk2xJLA&sysid=1 "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They’re the reason I’m running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47159%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qtWFrId3kCeaUOfsZXw15A&sysid=1 "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and
fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it’s too late.

---

---

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5qb1qu08lm2tsk8rdhfs45lvemsm9ri9suhk2k8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j61oj7c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3m1qvcandti6qf00i9ut3q5hvvp5ugvhr5ui3h8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j61oj7c9h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn4qcaimoqdlmj3eo01us4c6j2d2hlk497rhs3t0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5j61oj7c9h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: John Gomez  - Campaign Manager
subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 10/21
body:
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjykthjy-kujkulhluu-z/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjykthjy-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 10/21/22
Good evening,With just over two weeks until Election Day 2022, Team Chabot isn't letting their foot off the pedal. Team Chabot is knocking thousands of doors a week. Congressman Chabot is knocking doors himself while attending events throughout the district and meeting with voters. This week we also have a new release on Nancy Pelosi coming to Ohio to campaign for Greg Landsman. Read on for these updates and more from the trail! **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot Knocking Doors_ Team Chabot is knocking thousands of doors a week. Congressman Chabot joined in and knocked doors in Anderson Township and Fairfax. We gave out dozens of yard signs and heard plenty of positive comments. Voters everywhere understand the need to get prices down and keep our neighborhoods safe. Responses have been very positive everywhere we go. Voters are ready to get this country back on track. _OH-01 Door Launches_ On Saturday, Congressman Chabot attended door launches in both Hamilton County and Warren County. Both events were well attended and shows the energy and enthusiasm Republicans have up and down the ballot. Everyone is working hard for big Republican wins this November. _Emergency Services Day_ Last weekend, Congressman Chabot attended Emergency Services Day in Anderson Township. Congressman Chabot was proud to show his support for our local first responders. This event was also a great opportunity for families to connect with first responders and learn more about what they do to keep us safe. _Visit to Reading Police Department_ This week, Congressman Chabot met with Reading Chief of Police Bryan Edens and Fire Chief Todd Owens. They discussed how Congress can support our first responders and reverse the damage that radical defund-the-police politicians have done to our public safety. _Hyde Park Farmer's Market_ Sunday morning, Congressman Chabot attended the Hyde Park Farmer's Market. It was a beautiful fall morning for a great community event like this! _Warren County GOP Homecoming_ Last Friday, the Warren County GOP hosted its first annual Homecoming event. It was a very fun event with a lot of great people in attendance. Happy to attend and look forward to next year's event! **_New Release - Greg Landsman Welcomes Former Boss Nancy Pelosi to Ohio to Support Campaign as Their Shared Agenda Crushes Family Budgets and Small Businesses_** _Pelosi Visit to Boost Landsman Puts Focus on His Support for Unchecked Tax-and-Spend, Inflation-Fueling Agenda_ Congressman Chabot released the following statement on U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi traveling to Ohio to participate in a fundraiser for her former staffer and First District candidate Greg Landsman."Greg Landsman welcoming his former boss Nancy Pelosi to Ohio to support his campaign should tell First District voters all they need to know about his priorities and how he would vote if elected to Congress," said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. "Landsman learned his values working for Nancy Pelosi and would be a rubber-stamp for her out-of-control tax-and-spend agenda that is crushing First District families and small businesses with historic inflation.""On the campaign trail, Landsman refused to put rising costs or inflation in his top three issues, said 'what does it matter' when asked about his support of Pelosi and her inflation-fueling agenda, bragged about being a former staffer for Pelosi," Gomez continued. "And on the Cincinnati City Council, Landsman put his Pelosi-inspired values to work by voting to increase taxes eight times and calling for an increase to the county sales tax -- increasing the burden on already strained family budgets. First District families should reject the unchecked Pelosi agenda in Washington and reject her candidate for Congress Greg Landsman." **_Early Voting Information_** Early voting is officially here. Early voting is a safe, secure, and convenient way to make sure you get your ballot in without having to worry about any unexpected challenges on Election Day.Early voting takes place at your county Board of Elections. I included their addresses below:_Hamilton County Board of Elections_ - 4700 Smith Road, Cincinnati, OH 45212 _Warren County Board of Elections_ - 520 Justice Dr, Lebanon, OH 45036For more information on hours for voting, click [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjykthjy-kujkulhluu-y/)! Click [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjykthjy-kujkulhluu-j/) for an absentee request form. **_This Week 's Blog - "A Clear Choice"_**This week's blog is about the stark differences between Congressman Chabot's record of success and Greg Landsman's record of radicalism and extremism:_" Unlike being a longtime tax cutter like myself, my opponent is the real deal when it comes to [raising taxes](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjykthjy-kujkulhluu-t/). He voted to raise taxes eight times on City Council. He voted to raise the property tax even though he said it was too high. He wanted to raise the sales tax. Team Chabot is knocking thousands of doors a week. Congressman Chabot is knocking doors himself while attending events throughout the district and meeting with voters. This week we also have a new release on Nancy Pelosi coming to Ohio to campaign for Greg Landsman. Read on for these updates and more from the trail! Responses have been very positive everywhere we go. Voters are ready to get this country back on track. OH-01 Door Launches On Saturday, Congressman Chabot attended door launches in both Hamilton County and Warren County. Both events were well attended and shows the energy and enthusiasm Republicans have up and down the ballot. Everyone is working hard for big Republican wins this November. Emergency Services Day Last weekend, Congressman Chabot attended Emergency Services Day in Anderson Township. Congressman Chabot was proud to show his support for our local first responders. This event was also a great opportunity for families to connect with first responders and learn more about what they do to keep us safe. Visit to Reading Police Department This week, Congressman Chabot met with Reading Chief of Police Bryan Edens and Fire Chief Todd Owens. They discussed how Congress can support our first responders and reverse the damage that radical defund-the-police politicians have done to our public safety. Hyde Park Farmer's Market Sunday morning, Congressman Chabot attended the Hyde Park Farmer's Market. It was a beautiful fall morning for a great community event like this! Friend,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276e2b60304c476b90bc1fb32615ad93&_e=9_XSqzovXJr9y8B87v8X08ShwxgxAyWh1QaX_Ty2IXD2iMkOf-SF0QlYpD93Gt_IxhW4seDsi_zkIf8D0pIA0uNSNXIitLc-SfmZc5XXcvfA_NO7kpZlZTQxeusf2bkbxlt_9zvnvNRgYXiZVfgpXUZeVr1gg3eGsgbuUYAofdVNbd8z6SQcdX1-hkpEa_vzckkbznoduaXJFKkLI99L-nYDr4vUndTtPNqR28yIjvPmAgmDwp9qZp2uHzF6iGTy5lKBaQb3Za6A8jJ3_-LtxpZ5YYZWn78W7vi7fngfd1Q%3D)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276e2b60304c476b90bc1fb32615ad93&_e=9_XSqzovXJr9y8B87v8X08ShwxgxAyWh1QaX_Ty2IXD2iMkOf-SF0QlYpD93Gt_IxhW4seDsi_zkIf8D0pIA0uNSNXIitLc-SfmZc5XXcvfA_NO7kpZlZTQxeusf2bkbxlt_9zvnvNRgYXiZVfgpXfoJcQJMFGqxEWgsEjxbDTNx3qq1CHpupSH_9s_HxqcimKOkxdCzIpWnvqhZ9apyldkejelB0XDb8D8W8DE4om_SB9rR6PMM3p0aYdGGbt76NhNFuwQi7RXIt4PuVS45UMI6UbLElm4hJIFVz-_jJ9g%3D)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

clean_body: Friend, Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts. "Why?" you may ask. As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us. Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities. I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities: No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total. Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it. No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders. No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test. The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above? Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this. " One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity." This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today. It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities. We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. Our message is about UNITING people -that means all people \- not division. Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping. Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters. BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. body:
We are in the home stretch. Time of all hands to be on deck. Here's how you can participate this week.
---
| |
---|---|---
|
# This Saturday: GOTV Rally in Kernersville
Join District 6 for a free BBQ, Meet & Greet, 50-50 Raffle and volunteer sign up. Get your signs, voter guides and just help us Rally to GOTV! Early voting is looking good so far. Noon to 3pm! See you there. For more info: [ncgop6.org](https://christiancastelli.cmail20.com/t/r-l-tjykjytk-bikurkihrl-y/)
# Countdown to Victory
17 days and counting down to November 8. What an exciting week! Christian traveled to the southern border, did media hits with KC O'Dea, WFMY, Kernersville News and more! He appeared with Ronna McDaniel and Sen. Rick Scott (FL) at the RNC Community Center in Greensboro. Later tha evening, Castelli attended what would have been a debate at High Point University, but Kathy decided not to attend. Then, Friday, he did attend the candidate forum at Friends Home West where he showed his command of national security and foreign affairs and she talked about...birth control. Christian ended the week on stage with Tyrus and several FoxNews personalities in downtown Greensboro. Photos from that appearance will be posted next week. Look for our NEW AD on television. We have linked it here. Share with everyone. Kathy Manning has told so many lies about Castelli and this video rebukes a few of them. | Christian relayed some of his border stories at the JVF dinner Tuesday. | | HPU Students were well-researched on the issues! But, where's Kathy?
---|---|---

Ronna came to town to help stump for Republican candidates. | | It was a strong fundraising week (keep 'em coming), including an event at Sedgefield CC.
---|---|---

| This Green Beret doesn't shy away from the competition! |
---|---|---

### EARLY VOTING Links beloW
Each county has its own schedule, so please click through for locations and hours. We needat least one A-Team member greeting voters at each location. Some counties are coordinating this, using combined slate cards, etc. Please make your plan now to volunteer during Early Voting (where over 60% of the vote is cast).
[Guilford](https://christiancastelli.cmail20.com/t/r-l-tjykjytk-bikurkihrl-j/)
[Rockingham](https://christiancastelli.cmail20.com/t/r-l-tjykjytk-bikurkihrl-t/)

[Caswell](https://christiancastelli.cmail20.com/t/r-l-tjykjytk-bikurkihrl-h/) \- call Elections Director
### come dial with us!
Beginning Oct 25, we will move to THREE midweek call nights. Join us Tuesdays, Wednesdas and Thursdays - at Castelli HQ or from home. ALL counties are welcome to participate! To get set up, contact [Catherine Cavenaugh](mailto:catherine.cavenaugh@ncgop.org?subject=Castelli%20Call%20Nights%20-%20I'm%20In!).

body:

|

| | | Friend, I just want to start off with...I'm so sorry.

I hate that I'm emailing you like this. But I have an urgent update and I wanted you to hear it straight from me.

**I _just_ learned my far-left opponent raised over $22.5 MILLION last quarter.** That's not even taking into consideration the MASSIVE amounts of money that Pelosi and Schumer have invested in Florida to defeat me!

Democrats know that if they win this race they can wipe all of our accomplishments away and make sure conservatives never hold power again. Every day, I fight for conservative values in the Senate but if I don't have the resources to win my race, I'm worried we'll be overrun.

name: Candace Owens
subject: I’ve received death threats… here’s why
body:
All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zthc1rftciaf4477in79mvurqbei9qmiej6pnr80_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

Hello Friend,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc74j8d9a4b5d7ffrjd98qinrc969qfu94pvmbn0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Friend, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv4i5vb2d3l98iea9pnj9epstaedbdamts1ba8eg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0cpgb2qnqd71aijh6f2kl3ce8p571idiavl2vkg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhkmu1s4673ud3acvv5b1ap6bsndggmti24ekpag_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

* Entrepreneurship: Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not just talking a big game. . . Our Chapter members are actually connecting with community individuals to make a real impact in urban communities.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv4kvoj7f88r2fapi94gmpq4be8julddhjg3hbd8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. Our urban communities must learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens.

It's why BLEXIT holds summer and after-school programs to teach children about these important lessons.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv6d5f718psdcaq46d8teejuvlsmulunidqr8ar0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

* Presenting Our Message: The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. These are urban communities that others ignore, communities that rely on the mainstream media to write their narrative.

These aren't boring events, and we're not just preaching to the choir. They have music, art, and real conversations. Most importantly, they are fun!

These exciting events are brought to life because of our State Chapters. Their hard work and creativity help our message reach new people and inspires communities to be victors, not victims.

[_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmhd97q3fh0oqt40d60crqjvdnqcl0kvp1tdb8i0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

This is personal to me -- I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood, but now I found my exit.

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence forced upon us.**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.**

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by investing in our organization and helping us reach our goal of raising $50,000 this week. **Please click below to send your gift.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb2cv6rceul39spou7e2dfe8r1764ir7vlt8knp8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvm86ev0s9nuiv7ml39unpplm5q5cbjkno0o8gio_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3von477ciq7f1985uv9l6b73h4i7ipsf5k7kr8o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaufg4mhqchap8097a1405nd5pe12viq2pfhq9qg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z77p55einqm3nv3jt2bfa2c0m1j36lv97hivauc0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2mtbo6tmt4mgb018a8u71e60qtt21d5pen1pb78_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zao67pdtkkv73e53lhpcpkrrc69fcmu2gle1961o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zncdt6m7mj1aoqh8879cstqrst70j9fkrmeit8h8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zno04k8s7o1oav6vlfvrrd8galpn1qhpqd04i61g_rp22sh2s8i66or3c5gmeoj1c5h2bs)

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
Co-Founder & President
BLEXIT Foundation

My husband asked.
My daughter asked.
And now I’m asking you again.

That’s how important my midnight deadline is.

Derek, I need to pull back the curtain and explain where things stand: [**FIRST:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53110396/374431796/91184225?refcode=20221022_em_fr_b1_spm_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7aGZUwIRnSnZ_MCpHLWjXL-x_NArGPytkYH0ooM-8Q=) Projections revealed that after redistricting, Republicans view my seat as a prime target. [**THEN:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53110397/374431832/91184225?refcode=20221022_em_fr_b1_spm_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7aGZUwIRnSnZ_MCpHLWjXL-x_NArGPytkYH0ooM-8Q=) National Republicans added me to their official target list and attacked me with vicious lies. [**NOW:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53110398/374431839/91184225?refcode=20221022_em_fr_b1_spm_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7aGZUwIRnSnZ_MCpHLWjXL-x_NArGPytkYH0ooM-8Q=) Kevin McCarthy has amassed $98 MILLION to attack Democrats like me and flip this seat red. [**Derek: I refuse to be the “tipping point” seat that hands Republicans a one-seat Majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53110401/374431874/91184225?refcode=20221022_em_fr_b1_spm_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7aGZUwIRnSnZ_MCpHLWjXL-x_NArGPytkYH0ooM-8Q=) [_**I know I already emailed this week, but if I can’t raise another $12,392 before midnight, I could fall behind in my race and we could lose control of the House for years to come. If we want to save the House, falling short is not an option. My race -- and control of the entire House -- hinges on what we do in the next 13 hours. Will you rush in $15 now? >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53110411/374431894/91184225?refcode=20221022_em_fr_b1_spm_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7aGZUwIRnSnZ_MCpHLWjXL-x_NArGPytkYH0ooM-8Q=) Derek, my seat is in real danger: \-- Donald Trump vowed to run for president if Republicans flip the House.

\-- Kevin McCarthy just broke a fundraising record to go for it.

\-- And multiple Republicans have jumped into the race to take me down.

It's truly frightening what Democrats will say or do to win.

They're not above lying. They are not above taking things conservatives say out of context.**Democrats are not above making up facts that fit into their narrative.** Democrats have not and will not play fairly, and it's the job of Republicans in Congress to call them out when they abuse the power entrusted to them by the voters (their employers) who sent them to D.C. to represent their interests.

* Democrats don't want to talk about inflation.
* Democrats don't want to talk about funding for 87,000 new IRS agents
* Democrats don't want to talk about Hunter Biden
* Democrats don't want to talk about the booming economy under President Trump

So, when recently I appeared at the CPAC conference and indicated the importance of investigating the **Biden family's business dealings** \- the activities of Hunter Biden -Democrats pounced, framing unrelated remarks I made about President Trump in a way that could lead some to believe I want to rig the next presidential election.

**Ignoring and redirecting is what Democrats do best** , Peter. Democrats want the American public to believe the only reason we want to hold this administration accountable is to tank President Biden's reelection - but I've got news for them: **he's doing a great job of doing that himself**.

Peter, without the adequate resources to punch back against the fake news media and the lies Democrats in Congress would have the American public believe, Republicans may not win in November. That's why I'm asking for your help today. **[Will you chip in $5 to ensure we're able to get the truth in front of voters before the lies take hold and it's too late?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61711718:JyZ_NgVJN:m:1:3253819041:ACF1AE688DA2675DBE806548C4BB5F03:r)**

Anyone who knows anything about Hunter Biden and his business dealings knows that the president's son was up to no good - for a long time. The media suppressed stories about him in the leadup to the 2020 presidential election, and now, **Democrats are lying to the American public to try and avoid anything that would bring to light Democrat's shady backroom business dealings once again.**

Please, don't let them win. **[I need you to stand with us today before it's too late.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61711718:JyZ_NgVJN:m:1:3253819041:ACF1AE688DA2675DBE806548C4BB5F03:r)**

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the "Cut, Cap and Balance" plan get the country's finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

He built a conservative, pro-family voting record, and authored an alternative state budget that balanced without raising taxes. Ignoring and redirecting is what Democrats do best , Peter. Democrats want the American public to believe the only reason we want to hold this administration accountable is to tank President Biden's reelection - but I've got news for them: he's doing a great job of doing that himself. Peter, without the adequate resources to punch back against the fake news media and the lies Democrats in Congress would have the American public believe, Republicans may not win in November. "Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

clean_body: Friend, Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts. "Why?" you may ask. As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us. Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities. I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities: No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total. Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it. No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders. No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test. The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above? Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this. " One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity." This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today. It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities. We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. Our message is about UNITING people -that means all people \- not division. Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping. Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters. BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Friend,

While
many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew
the giant, they likely don't know his full story-especially the
tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to
repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about
fathers and sons.

King
David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of
life's most important questions, including: What are my
responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I
lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way
to lead others?

Taught by
Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, "The David
Story: Shepherd, Father, King" examines the Old Testament books
of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores
David's character and the consequences of his choices on his
family and the people of Israel.

This is
why we've produced our online course, "The David Story: Shepherd,

family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you'll learn
more about what truly matters in life.

I hope
you'll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with

homeschool curriculum.

As any parent who is raising children in this district knows, our children’s education is more than a top priority...it is a non-negotiable right to receive quality education, have the best educational resources, a safe learning environment, and the best social and emotional support possible. We have some of the best public schools in the country, but sadly, we also have schools that continue to fail our students.
Parents and educators throughout the district have shared with me their support for School Resource Officers and the need for mental health services, yet Jim Himes voted against “Protecting Our Kids Act” that would have provided our schools with SROs and mental health counselors to close gaps in school security, strengthen active shooter preparedness efforts, with all costs offset by unused state and local COVID funds. These were unused funds to protect our children and he voted “NO”.
On top of the educational inequality, I know that COVID-related isolation has created a disparity of learning loss and we need to ensure this never happens again! Congress recently approved funding of additional student mental health programs, but parents deserve to know that Jim Himes voted against an amendment to ensure that parental notification occurs when a student receives mental health, gender and reproductive health counseling in their schools.

As a mother of five children, I’ve experienced first hand how critical it is that parents are central in response if their child is suicidal, or is experiencing any other medical, social, emotional or physical distress. Parents are the primary caregivers for their children and have ultimate responsibility for them, not the government.

clean_body: | | | | As any parent who is raising children in this district knows, our children’s education is more than a top priority...it is a non-negotiable right to receive quality education, have the best educational resources, a safe learning environment, and the best social and emotional support possible. jaymestevensonforcongress.com As any parent who is raising children in this district knows, our children’s education is more than a top priority...it is a non-negotiable right to receive quality education, have the best educational resources, a safe learning environment, and the best social and emotional support possible. We have some of the best public schools in the country, but sadly, we also have schools that continue to fail our students. Parents and educators throughout the district have shared with me their support for School Resource Officers and the need for mental health services, yet Jim Himes voted against “Protecting Our Kids Act” that would have provided our schools with SROs and mental health counselors to close gaps in school security, strengthen active shooter preparedness efforts, with all costs offset by unused state and local COVID funds. These were unused funds to protect our children and he voted “NO”. On top of the educational inequality, I know that COVID-related isolation has created a disparity of learning loss and we need to ensure this never happens again! Congress recently approved funding of additional student mental health programs, but parents deserve to know that Jim Himes voted against an amendment to ensure that parental notification occurs when a student receives mental health, gender and reproductive health counseling in their schools. As a mother of five children, I’ve experienced first hand how critical it is that parents are central in response if their child is suicidal, or is experiencing any other medical, social, emotional or physical distress. Parents are the primary caregivers for their children and have ultimate responsibility for them, not the government. As your next Congresswoman, I will hold accountable Washington bureaucrats who try to bring back policies that proved harmful to our children and ensure our children are safe, and receive the best tools and resources for success. I will be a champion in Washington for Connecticut children and their future. Thank you for your support. Jayme Stevenson Candidate for Congress, District 4 Connecticut | | ABOUT JAYME I’m running for Congress to bring common sense and balance back to Washington and to give voice to the people of the 4th Congressional District who have been left behind by politicians working for themselves and a national party agenda. Happy Saturday, folks!

Today, I’m helping our volunteers and organizers launch canvasses in Niles
and Cleveland before heading off to Lima for our Workers First Rally this
afternoon.

But I can’t be in 10 places at once, and our folks here on the ground need
some backup—which is why I’m coming to

volunteers and organizers are able to reach the voters we’ll need to flip
Ohio blue and expand our Democratic Senate majority?

possible.

That’s why we’re launching an Emergency 24-hour Field Organizing Fund to

19 miles to go, friend. We're in the final stretch.
As I'm writing you this email, I've been traveling from one rally to the next and just got back on the campaign bus. With only 17 days left before Election Day, I'm visiting every single corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53115676/374451973/580313503?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3629-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWRjNDc0Ni0yMzUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gnzv_4q1F-y_OhReX6K3z63eTufk92k5fBd2aEIWIng=)
I've had a lot of long days and sleepless nights on my tour across Florida, so people often ask me what keeps me going.
Here's what I tell them: I think about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader that understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I think about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy.
And, in the background of all of this, I hear my mother's voice in my head telling me, "Never tire of doing good, Val."
That's what energizes me as I travel to all 67 Florida counties to surge ahead in this race. I know winning will make a meaningful difference for Florida – and for our country – but polls show me neck and neck with Marco Rubio right now.
That's why I'm asking for your support in the final stretch of my campaign. Unlike Marco Rubio, my average donation is just $29.04, so I rely on people like you to help me fund voter outreach and move forward in these final few weeks.
I'm about to hop off the bus at my next campaign event, so I have to ask: If you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you split $5 today between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's? subject: Is America about to fall?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CARLOS GIMENEZ FOR CONGRESS
body:
We’ve got to do something about it

Fellow Patriot,

When I envisioned what my life in America would look like, I didn’t picture this.

Sure, through hard work and tenacity I was able to secure my American Dream. But will my grandchildren have the same opportunities that I had?

I fear for their future, friend.

Because a wave of radical socialist policies are taking over this country.
HELP ME STOP THE RADICAL LEFT (https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=)

The America that my parents and I fled to in our most desperate hour was not one that would support Defunding the Police or taxing the middle class into poverty.

The America that we fled to was the shining city on a hill. A place where freedom flourished and opportunity was plentiful. Life was what you made of it, and success was only measured by the values that you held dear.
https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=

My story is not unlike thousands of others you may have heard before. A young boy in the streets of Cuba, the community that I was born in was booming. Businesses, family values and faith kept us all going.

But then it all changed.

Radial Leftists rose to power. My peers and I were beginning to be indoctrinated into an anti-American mindset in schools. And the cost to live became so expensive that before we knew what hit us, nearly everyone was relying on government handouts just to survive. Sound familiar?

My parents knew that we had to get off the island. There was no longer a meaningful life to be had for their children.

And now, as I look at the country that once saved me, I have the same questions about the life I am leaving my grandchildren to build for themselves.

What does freedom even look like anymore?
Who decides what is politically correct or who gets canceled?

How did we get here so quickly?

Look, fellow patriot, I’ve seen one communist “revolution” in my lifetime. And I’m going to fight like hell to prevent another one. (https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=)

President Reagan said it best: “If we lose freedom here, there is no place to escape to. This is the last stand on earth.”

There is nowhere in the world to flee like my family and I did when I was a young boy. This is it.

The promise of American freedom is quickly turning into nothing more than folklore.

We HAVE to do something about it. We may be down, but we’re not out yet.

My entire adult life, I have proven that I am willing to put myself in harm's way to protect my community and the people I love.

Now, I am taking my values and experiences as a former Fire Chief and leading the charge against socialism in the halls of Congress.

President Trump and Governor DeSantis trust me to get the job done. Will you join them in supporting my fight? (https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=)

This is not just about me and my family. This is about your family too. This is about the next generation. This is about preserving the American Dream.

I can’t do it alone.

So I am asking that you stand by my side as I rush into the field to put out the flame of socialism, which is spreading like wildfire all across our country. (https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=)

Thank you for helping me save the country we love,
https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=

Carlos A. Gimenez

https://secure.winred.com/carlos-gimenez-for-congress/gimenez-bio-av/?utm_source=prospecting&utm_medium=ha-email&utm_campaign=20221021_e000668-cg_bio-longform-one_av&utm_content=av&recurring=true&amount=

>From Cuba to Congress, Carlos Gimenez is the American Dream personified.

As a child, Carlos and his family fled Cuba following the communist revolution. Now, Carlos is fighting in Congress to ensure that his children and grandchildren are never forced to make the same decision.

Carlos Gimenez is a steadfast fighter for freedom and conserving the American way of life. Support his mission. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Always Fighting to Create & Support Good-Paying Georgia Jobs
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor, Coming from a family of twelve kids with two hardworking parents, I believe in the dignity of work and know nothing is more important to a family's financial health and security than a stable, good-paying job. **__** **_That 's why I've fought hard in the Senate to support and create good-paying jobs, and bring economic opportunity to the Peach State. Here are just a handful of examples: _**
* When there was a legal dispute between two companies that threatened jobs in Commerce, Georgia, I brought folks back to the table--**ultimately saving 2,600 jobs in the short term and creating 10,000 in the long term in Jackson County.

**
* At the height of the pandemic, **I led the fight to direct much-needed economic relief to over 190,000 Georgia small businesses** that help sustain communities across our state.

* **I championed tax incentives that have been signed into law and will boost solar manufacturers like QCells in Dalton, Georgia,** the largest solar panel manufacturer in the western hemisphere. QCells is now expanding in the area and **pledged to create 470 new good-paying jobs.

**
* I led the effort for Georgia in the Senate to get a bipartisan jobs and competition bill across the finish line. The CHIPS and Science Act, which is now law, will help **support jobs at places like Kia Motors ' West Point, Georgia facility** by investing in domestic manufacturing. The new law will also **train up the next generation of Georgians to work the jobs of the future** , and help **create new regional tech hubs potentially in places like Warner Robins, Columbus, or Savannah that will bring new economic opportunities to workers and innovators in our communities.

**
* And, I've championed efforts to **strengthen broadband access across the state,** especially in our rural areas, because none of our state's economic growth and development is possible without reliable and high-speed broadband connections. **I 'm proud to have secured over $650 million in federal funding to help connect every Georgian to the internet**.

**This is only the beginning.** As your U.S. Senator, I am going to continue using _every_ tool at my disposal to keep Georgia's economy moving forward. I am deeply proud of my work to create and support Georgia jobs, and I won't stop fighting to bring _more_ jobs to every corner of our great state. Know that I am deeply committed to making sure Washington does its part to ensure Georgia families and businesses have everything they need to succeed and thrive for years to come.
Until next time, neighbors-keep the faith and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. If you have any questions, please contact our office [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16890.12248893.6024882.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f&redir_log=51402161759365).

Good morning, Peter. Here’s a fun fact you may not know about me: I was born at SwedishAmerican Hospital in Rockford -- right here in Illinois’ 17th District. Call me old-fashioned, but I think it’s important that we elect a representative who has called this district home for ***at least*** the majority of their lifetime. As someone running to represent my hometown, I’m definitely doing so with a heightened sense of duty. That’s what decades of building relationships and absorbing local values will do to you, and it’s why I always felt a deep sense of responsibility as a meteorologist -- helping my community understand the risks and make well-informed decisions. **My opponent Esther King only moved to Western Illinois because she thought her chances of being elected were better here than in Chicago.** She’s not a homegrown candidate. In my humble opinion, she hasn’t earned the trust of IL-17 residents. But here's the deal: My opponent has a _near endless_ supply of funds propping her up thanks to Kevin McCarthy's super PAC. They believe that with _just_ enough resources, they can pull it off. **We're doing things differently.** This campaign is funded by over 12,000 donors -- including donors from _every_ county in this district. That's by design, Peter. We need to send a message that this seat should go to someone who will fight for us -- not Kevin McCarthy. **[We still need support to make sure our voices aren't drowned out by the super PACs attacking us. If you can, please chip in $5 to keep our momentum going. Let’s elect someone focused on securing a better future for working families in Illinois and everywhere else.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zSJ2-Su0o8Ni7LeDh2MrPPUvpXBRo6wFsFkfdA82RDzDyo1p55-fykgQROSkJheX853OH3aMIEoQ7bF_3oqWYRoFnvhR3rab18v6_ykw7Iqt6IeF9BY0oEuL1jcH3gfvHrEdxyGapqatrXXyGCgtyW8RFLq9bpLWr7xbvxxZCB0XO7mGoOqgGDPLvE-PycBTlsoYoamz92leKYVJmQM8x6BKjdwhzwZgWtsx3IyhWqMztvNpToPP8hPa5CknHmzGc--G67DMdohFePwsbrZVVq8fkiiu0XHqKNfx2IjS-TnGFJQi-5SHLZTGLfRJoqtVYZwEkm1iarjSfFzJzUSvp9/3qi/93_uKxSSS-a5S_vj7Leeqg/h1/kRrDxen3c1-dqPcYCfcsjCC9kzlan0B6xyfiKV88Cqc)** This race could swing either way in the final weeks – and the more grassroots support we can muster, the better our chances of victory on November 8th. Fellow American - MSNBC has called me every name in the book during this campaign.

**They've likened me to a slave doing the bidding of my white masters; they've called me a "token" Black Republican.**

After my debate with Senator Warnock, their hosts took to the airwaves to tear me down AGAIN.

**Joy Reid and Alex Wagner on _Alex Wagner Tonight_ agreed with a college professor's editorial that I am just a "warm body that can be used as a pawn." Joy Reid further said I was only useful as a Black candidate because I'm "compliant" enough to vote the way Donald Trump and "White Republicans" tell me to.**

**THIS IS RACIST AND DISGUSTING.**

_I'm a proud Black man with conservative values. Because I don't fit the narrative of how the Left demands that I think and act, they declare me to be a**"token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," "not part of the Black community,"** a **"negro,"** a **"white insult to black people,"** or a **"house n*****"** (all of which I've been called recently)._

What's also disturbing is that my opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so. _

**Unfortunately, Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing.**

They've likened me to a slave doing the bidding of my white masters; they've called me a "token" Black Republican. After my debate with Senator Warnock, their hosts took to the airwaves to tear me down AGAIN. Joy Reid and Alex Wagner on Alex Wagner Tonight agreed with a college professor's editorial that I am just a "warm body that can be used as a pawn." Joy Reid further said I was only useful as a Black candidate because I'm "compliant" enough to vote the way Donald Trump and "White Republicans" tell me to. THIS IS RACIST AND DISGUSTING. I'm a proud Black man with conservative values. Because I don't fit the narrative of how the Left demands that I think and act, they declare me to be a"token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," "not part of the Black community," a "negro," a "white insult to black people," or a "house n*" (all of which I've been called recently). What's also disturbing is that my opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so.
