name: Defend the Constitution
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73ad2cada4a64c8384adb23d6f1fcfe2&_e=V7Le4pL9F8nGnk06Qdf699nC4-MeUFR9jp88t0rtWSkAsIBiiURpDUdXR8hcP8-R5d-SjXuV9QrBf55O4H422w2YHPBzn8EQqZbFfkhmPUYIlVfV3GMwtKvBSugZPIHkw_VlbtR20qxljCviMO2i9ti_a3KrReGaZ4qJ_MDalnyxzW88nZj1OlaUQbe9gZyDTsqngrPjjbilEYyfsYRTVnoRMA6jIXpsu06zGwVqjWkBEQSA4tJloWqjIhKpNUnUuU9n1InGvmUb2wHGeiefVaDUyJV8u1x472B-eg_yHVBtDwEWRd9RC4Zi9eBGBDdqVGLVaZ-v7S9BoOKhUT6pQYFZjNtvSpbjaYFK21ADWMWw8yBDA57eY8eObdGHzsYE4Zw5rmGjSKIh3WF-dQP1Yg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132656?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,
**This week I went to Washington.** Whatever you might think about some of the people there, DC it is an impressive capital city.

The Capitol dome was gleaming in the October sunshine. The Washington monument looked stunning against a clear blue sky. Even the White House looked immaculate.
---
|
---
| **I went to Washington to meet lots of fascinating folk at key conservative think tanks and foundations.** It was good to learn more about what they are doing to fight for freedom at a federal level.

It was doubly exciting to discuss how the Mississippi Center for Public Policy can be part of a national movement to renew America.

**Mississippi might be one of the smaller states in the Union, but I found _lots_ of interest in how we managed to cut the state income tax.** Conservatives in the capital also wanted to hear about the occupational licensing law we passed, the bill we enacted to combat Critical Race theory and how we helped defeat the Biden vaccine mandate.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=2f683db427&e=5703353baa)
---
_What’s gone wrong with the mainstream media? Douglas discusses_
| **Our policy wins are important because almost all the great policy innovations in America come from the states, not from the federal government in Washington**. For example, it was the mid-west, not DC, that came up with Charter Schools. It was cities that pioneered zero tolerance policing. **Today it is states like Mississippi that show the way with tax cuts and deregulation.**
---
|
---
| **Many conservatives I spoke to in Washington are upbeat.** Some seem to think that conservatives would do well in the mid-terms next month. Several said they were more optimistic than they were just a couple of months ago.

I am optimistic, too. Not just because of what the conservatives might achieve in the mid-terms, but because what we are doing to move the dial in Mississippi is part of a conservative revival underway across America.

Have a wonderful weekend!
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

Friend, the No. 3 House Republican, Elise Stefanik, has endorsed my extremist Republican opponent - the latest among the GOP establishment to throw the weight of their radical party at this race, all in an effort to defeat me.
I want to take just a moment to explain why this matters - and why your support, right now, is more urgent than ever.
Elise Stefanik and my opponent are remarkably similar. They both used to be moderate Republicans - until Donald Trump gained his chokehold on the GOP. From that point on, they both sold their souls to Trump. They radically changed positions on key issues. Desperate for Trump's approval, they moved from moderate to his brand of extremism.
This is, by and large, illustrative of the vast majority of the Republican Party - increasingly willing to parrot the positions of, and bow down to, Donald Trump. **It 's why one top Trump acolyte, Elise Stefanik, has wholly endorsed another, my opponent - so they can flip this seat and the Senate for Donald Trump.**
I will never stop standing up to Trump and his Republicans. I will never stop fighting against their extremist agenda. But Stefanik is but one of many top-brass Republicans - from RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel to Senate GOP head Rick Scott and Donald Trump himself - who are going "all in" to defeat me. **_And they have tens of millions of dollars in resources to pull it off, whereas I 'm falling $4,713 short of my next midnight fundraising goal._**

Mike DeWine has been in office since I was 10 months old. That’s 46 years of being out of step with Ohioans.

In that time, Mike DeWine has made plenty of money for himself and let his rich corporate friends bankroll his campaign in return for political favors, making it harder for Ohioans like us to deal with rising costs and stagnant wages. For instance, the company that pleaded guilty to the largest corruption scandal in Ohio history donated millions of dollars to get DeWine elected in 2018 and since then he’s given that company everything they wanted.

Meanwhile, in those same 46 years, I grew up in a union family and experienced first-hand what it means to be worried about how we’d pay for groceries and afford our mortgage after my dad got laid off. That’s why fighting for working families is so important to me.

I eventually became the mayor of Dayton, where I helped the city through the opioid crisis, fought tirelessly for commonsense action to prevent gun violence, and helped secure federal funding that has expanded broadband, delivered mental health resources, invested in Ohio police, and improved our neighborhoods.

The main thing Mike DeWine has done is increase his personal paycheck at your expense.

**Please read on for a personal message from Sen. Rev. Raphael Warnock:** Friend – thank you. I’m grateful to have grassroots folks like you standing alongside me in our critical fights for justice. Our midterm elections are taking place this November, and I need your help.

With Democrats’ razor-thin majority in the Senate, Republicans have to flip just one seat to retake control – and experts say that I’m the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection. clean_body: The perfect way to celebrate fall on the campaign trail.Elissa Slotkin for Congress | = | | | Get ready folks: we’re bringing back the Cider Mill Tour! = My district is home to quite a few cider mills and as a result, they’re a fall staple. Back in 2020, we made a day of visiting as many cider mills as we possibly could (we went to 10), as it was one of the few COVID-safe ways to meet some new faces. We quickly learned that this is a perfect way to celebrate fall on the campaign trail. So, we’ve decided to bring back the tour to stop back by some old favorites and visit some more cider mills in the new counties of the 7th! It’ll be an all-out affair as we meet some new faces and sample some of the best cider mid-Michigan has to offer. Make sure you follow along on my social media (you can find my twitter , my facebook , and my instagram ) on October 23rd to see the highlights from each stop. And, if you happen to be in the area, come say hi! = | = Elissa | | About Elissa Elissa Slotkin proudly represents Michigan’s 8th district in Congress. | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** October 22, 2022**CONTACT:** Gabriella Shanahan, [gabriella@scottgryder.com](mailto:gabriella@scottgryder.com)
---
**Kendall County Board Chairman Scott R. Gryder Signs Resolution Criticizing the SAFE-T Act**
---
**Oswego, Ill**. – Local law, national implications. The Safety, Accountability, Fairness and Equity-Today Act, known as the SAFE-T Act has raised concerns among 100 State’s Attorneys and a growing number of local and state officials.

Several initiatives of the SAFE-T act go into effect over the next few years. Most notably, beginning January 1, 2023, the elimination of cash bail is set to take effect. This severely limits the judiciary’s ability to set bail to hold the accused accountable, and it puts victims and their families in jeopardy of safety and security. When we let criminals free, our nation suffers. Under the SAFE-T Act, they will be free to travel and escape to their next crime without being held accountable with bail.

Radical politicians continue to unilaterally decide what is best for you and your family. They continue to pass bills without your input, without your voiced concerns, without the concerns of attorneys and law enforcement. Lauren Underwood refuses to acknowledge and condemn the SAFE-T act. Instead, she continues to campaign and accept money from radical, defund-the-police politicians.

I stand, and will continue to stand, with law enforcement, first responders, and victims and their families. Every individual has the right to feel safe and secure in their home and community. I will speak against and hold the line on bad legislation like I’ve done with this resolution.
One question that remains to be answered: where do you stand on the SAFE-T Act, Lauren?

###

Now more than ever, we must promote equity, invest in Maryland families, and make our state a better place to live for all. We need progressive leaders who are willing to take on the challenges our families struggle with every day.

With our next fundraising reporting deadline coming up tomorrow, we need 47 people to give TODAY to keep us on track so I can keep fighting for our families in Annapolis. Will you give what you can right now to make sure we don’t fall short?

Please, chip in whatever you can to help us stay on track to our next reporting deadline goal. We need 47 more donations today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=octemails]

Jazz

body:
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=51cb5d3684474a81b8448970e449ed41&_e=lWcclZr6rX6ZRTBCVKympghZiGIUhqBtBGrkBZJRgunoVeeD-NP_S8AyJ0CVGXZ79em9_FngMq1j4wT7SYOe7lWcIRJpq8OuIfIMk_KZYsAC-UDksT1i0SFkPYONWA1NowY9M-IBtV0QUR8qXSM_vc8Q-PGcUyf_AT8U9nyqQ1tH80ujEUAX71f8ljMlU64vOgqgrs2Rx94DKIsZkC8wiDPjh2Y0pJu6UfDQrWj52jTu81TBDuhEXMmb3Iwfumb85VBnHKdr_RZtavXBiU9XJ1CR9NxUEl9hXuxOtvstBGE%3D)

Hello Friend,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=51cb5d3684474a81b8448970e449ed41&_e=lWcclZr6rX6ZRTBCVKympghZiGIUhqBtBGrkBZJRgunoVeeD-NP_S8AyJ0CVGXZ79em9_FngMq1j4wT7SYOe7lWcIRJpq8OuIfIMk_KZYsAC-UDksT1i0SFkPYONWA1NowY9M-IBtV0QUR8qXSM_vfMDkXe4Z3wpXYtHQQlfFimIe5vXDupmOFZESncpcugRmLFh7VsRnn_EmHLqiHZ286JAtc66xRMCjmrjdDhQn5kWSKVLE1vdRPJGMek2cfroAm444K0QGLu9ZrLfeLWMd1ukDBC9egz1-V2vt8evboQ%3D)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Friend, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=51cb5d3684474a81b8448970e449ed41&_e=lWcclZr6rX6ZRTBCVKympghZiGIUhqBtBGrkBZJRgunoVeeD-NP_S8AyJ0CVGXZ79em9_FngMq1j4wT7SYOe7lWcIRJpq8OuIfIMk_KZYsAC-UDksT1i0SFkPYONWA1NowY9M-IBtV0QUR8qXSM_vXM29mzBz8eBnppgNBsjoWchsoK1F3rbCFrvK9n8VJ4alYZqNpRZmaBnLZcpo5aU45l0LGzqd4QhHkTbAZbUkBib17FL7lxQawiTTb5dVuH25qLFUFuCH1yjEHHe3KaoMyDlnAlIG_FSMbtXUF_AQrY%3D)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=51cb5d3684474a81b8448970e449ed41&_e=lWcclZr6rX6ZRTBCVKympghZiGIUhqBtBGrkBZJRgunoVeeD-NP_S8AyJ0CVGXZ79em9_FngMq1j4wT7SYOe7lWcIRJpq8OuIfIMk_KZYsAC-UDksT1i0SFkPYONWA1NowY9M-IBtV0QUR8qXSM_vaHC-2FNRCYQK6h-FNUAl1k1NlJQTITdxcnVEhv1_Fq7LjVi_Fko6p387GqGjaAiXlsmPPILne5KW8508gqcZGlKJLoz7VqfWJ9wi1_AdMPcGFLWtGEwbKzoNklwIvACANbQ9bQewU_DSzbRisusLaQ%3D)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: They would like nothing more than for Cori to lose
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Cori and I have had each other's backs from the very beginning.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221022-3523-header&t=1&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)
Hi,
I’m writing to you today about my sister-in-service, Cori Bush.
I've known Cori since 2017 when Justice Democrats recruited us both to run against establishment incumbents. Neither of us imagined we'd ever run for office, so we gravitated to each other from the very beginning.
We found solidarity organizing in our communities in St. Louis, The Bronx, and Queens. I vividly remember Cori calling me after a vehicle struck her arm, injuring her. Still, Cori persevered as we walked down the sidewalks of St. Louis together, her arm around me as I held her upright—she was determined to continue to knock every single door in her neighborhood to let them know that they mattered and that they were loved.
And when I joined Congress in 2019 to nonstop attacks from Donald Trump, Cori sent me uplifting notes of encouragement. Two years later, we were in Congress together, legislating and organizing on behalf of people and communities with the greatest need.
**Cori and I have had each other's backs from the very beginning.** _But now, Cori's counting on our people-powered movement to have hers._
**The far-right has attacked Cori at every chance, and those attacks will only increase as we get closer to Election Day.** [If you're with Cori and me in our mission to deliver transformative change, will you make a donation today to power Cori's re-election campaign?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221022.1LKEI2&refcode=em20221022-3523-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221022.1LKEI2&refcode=em20221022-3523-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)**
**Cori is _exactly_ the leader we need to represent St. Louis in Congress.** In her first months in office, we worked together to ensure local communities are prioritized in our response to the climate crisis with the introduction of the Green New Deal for Cities.
Then, when Congress adjourned last summer to go on vacation after failing to extend the eviction moratorium, it was Cori and I standing there asking what's next. Cori decided to take direct action by occupying the steps of the Capitol. For five days and four nights, we galvanized hundreds of activists, senators, and representatives to join us, successfully pushing the Biden administration to take action by extending the eviction moratorium. Cori’s power as a politi-vist, as an everyday person in Congress who has been unhoused, helped keep 11 million people at risk of eviction from being forced out onto the streets during a deadly pandemic.
Yet, at every turn, Cori has been demeaned, criticized, and attacked by Fox News and the far-right media. They would like nothing more than for her to lose her seat on November 8, _but we won't let that happen._
**Keeping Cori in Congress with me is absolutely critical to ensuring the future of our progressive movement.** Together, we will continue to work to enact Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, abortion access protections, and the anti-racist policies our communities need.
[Please, I'm asking: Will you chip in $5 or more today to help keep my friend, Cori Bush, in Congress? Your contribution will help Cori at a critical moment for her campaign.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221022.1LKEI2&refcode=em20221022-3523-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)
Thank you in advance for giving anything you can.
Pa’lante,
— Alexandria

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20221022?refcode=em20221022-3523-P_FND_ANO_GRM&t=23&refcode2=3523_2526796_kFGurZ&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20221022-3523-P_FND_ANO_GRM&t=24&akid=3523%2E2526796%2EkFGurZ)**

team,
These next 17 days before Election Day are going to be critical. And as we look ahead and lay out our plan to take this movement all the way, we’d like to take a moment to share exactly what we’re up against.

Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.
I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.
Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator.

I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you.
Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio _every single quarter_ and make this race competitive _._ But we're in danger of falling short of our midnight fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap.

If I'm honest, missing this goal could mean losing our momentum to flip Florida blue – because I'm already being outspent in key areas of the state and the latest polling has us slipping.
**So please – to help me close the 1-point gap in the polls and defeat my anti-choice, pro-Trump opponent, Marco Rubio – will you donate $5 to my campaign for Senate now? Here's the best link:** **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email-october](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53111221/374434253/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4912-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWNiMTIzNS0xYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a9raaV5T4hKNjO-bmh4rPwoCh8dZoq7C3Qg6myLRkZc=)**
Thank you for making history with me.

Val Demings

Peter, Ron DeSantis is America’s Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he’s called home since his birth.__

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2c5PmV99bN4-K0sSFiUPqG9PY8RSoJdhu2yLVhHQZ2vwCc9Zi-srdCjH3v6g7AlKXQAtum8uJDg6Xxc6yDsI551PY1w2Kb6GLp4JWcbd5vxljmoCga_TuASbviNC4dX7ETato7wzXi_u3-A_esBlEWX0w7fzT1VwPk-E9x2bgHSJI%3D)

| | Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain. Ron graduated Cum Laude from Yale University with a B.S. in History.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cDlZoQmJ7SaGrf5KF3T0xiqDDYNRGSnrY1bTrxrOFQt8knn9jys4Gl4KCYP6LuZJugo7Nql14ozvlkQLb_CEX4GSECD3yXyv9tburllNNIHwILXXPjlo6q8SfV4xF-dwvW8a56H3-uxoy_Fi4uhuUEXvVoimHTcNtwFxI_YxB91c%3D)
---
After graduating from college, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cajVpF2UXzb0750sstQi2YwNTF7PtEliwvvj9yfTvTMGzyXHjYJptmP6lWWp5Usr1ZtSCCbyITUAwZqCYHm2ZsYbdf1kV3j8Rvx22zcxJwi6XUowMOCAqKT55Jt0Kc4dRFJZCqyyLuwBdfk_0M_u4BAhHszYy6sIFmpFOUB3H9YY%3D)
---
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida. While on active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney’s Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators. Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cm12tkwve_S2l1sxxnTjiPaWCerP7mc_Iy_i7TMIG3YkGRDnDlybyr0SGJlKC2Zl97fuB9I7c36AAL276x5uvGgYsjzrL8crFPrhjoTflMdNosieMcOxx7xHSRK61oMyrnX8R5q1xqy9wZ1tYpFq_b959JkXfSk39KEuQeya3tls%3D)
---
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38% of the vote, Ron won his first three terms in Congress. While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cBE1syVtrdGJTvQasQc-1R4raL3U5GiHmCBuAPTYzbHGFkRxf0LyWRNEuA8l1wB_DIY1Olt8M0v3mB1nQc4MNOlebW0y2EOAzEoOxPSSCbaMd7Qtloth4d99-Ja0ylFYBCHVFrR7ECblsHx7z0V0lnSYLXSWkDxOCHUM-piM2aOY%3D)
---
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world. In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years. I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cIjOVHzM-uEoQL3jGIG03Qq1Sq1MqjSUrmmwtcBpMGapY47TiN0XwhkXBts1VVpz53yzZaHBmzAshubgGdTpAii-H-7eUO-c2lqhzh4O7n0qRiaKdpAIi7DJK7Q2zbfme7NeC6r1zfs01a4ybYHfHt7zzjU6KzwD-Gv_wI2u5pbM%3D)
---
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he passed legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business. As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state. But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cNJIDhFxWGIR1Vy9UuAxKBy6Ah6aaCY_252v5BDsNUbNb-KcAe8i0f9VM-XPcRoV5Qu_f3oluhjrVgKkBBjtDv1O_6UtEuA0bvGJ9xQ2jLNhotDqAn_Giabel3Nl2UjL_vSzw2oXzJUGgqeOwmYVhzX_AKMEUnda6kz6huaHTs0M%3D)
---
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands. Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children. Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies. I can you tell Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs you to stand with him. _[**Will you stand with my husband today to protect our state? >>>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cZjU3AW5w0bMgpxBszTbbN0FwUvtMyIa7lZ-QMP7xOr3SoL6Wzk1BeJVq56KKDm7O1XClJUsEAO_Mot3ZF8urti4kGz6DCZhoMHUrXJeQsQff5Zh_js7G11pw4vzW66_EKZ5igebBQ0k5jPFF_diOZLpywcHXShWTaXyUekl2F3U%3D)_ [**STAND WITH GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b832b9a6a60c4167a0d2ee8f5d81d627&_e=cga6deOTOcog_Aq9r3hyOjlobgAQeGwBEIbKjulXYfomL3gxLbo_K70GamldYxmUVdcsXrhSa_yg_P4IB70gVhAvseA7AyIxJ0wdGLyDdqDqxKg7ixVEgEA1Q95SXjwhX51V-Zm-4xB3I-Y06GYSdQ3KhoP9u4cbU3Uk2htKRHSSO7S13bREP81NYQOZHu2cS4ACL0AYR3FxXKO-X4WL-Z6DdCZMjxbZ846pFEz7MnvD5og3-EDEmt5ThvtYsVYKch54_Kza6hhNZegyMMkoJfBlQY82FN6cjX6u9795X1NwbIUZGmSwUR0gJrO8qqSF0EPQ9J3h1IHwCwqLMj3v2gv7SH5Tbwxo5ClPMGkBF0o%3D)Sincerely, Casey DeSantis

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38% of the vote, Ron won his first three terms in Congress. While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives. Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world. In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years. I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding. As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he passed legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business. As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state. But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. That is who Ron DeSantis is. He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands. Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children. Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies. I can you tell Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs you to stand with him. , Casey DeSantis | | | | Sponsored by Friends of Ron DeSantis | | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | | |

body:
I’m reaching out with an urgent request, team.
The MAGA Republican running against me, Tiffany Smiley, raised $6 million last quarter —almost double what my team and I raised.
This puts Smiley in the position to ramp up her ads and reach more voters with her misleading message. At this critical point in the race we need your help to fight back. Can you spit a $5 contribution now? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/gfs_pm?refcode=jtk3725-bu-nd]
We knew Republicans in Washington state and across the country would pour money into this race to prop up Smiley—a candidate who was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and will be a rubberstamp for his extreme agenda. But that much money at this point in the race has the potential to make a big difference on the outcome in November.
I’ve always said we can’t take anything for granted, and that could not be more true than it is right now. You all have come through time and time again—but I’m asking you to dig deep now and chip in $5 or whatever you can to me and Kirsten Gillibrand. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/gfs_pm?refcode=jtk3725-bu-nd]
Together, I know we can win.
Thank you,
Patty Murray

Hi team, Eric Lynn, the Democratic nominee for Florida's 13th Congressional District, has a plan for the future of Pinellas County and the country. Unfortunately, we don't think his opponent, Anna Paulina Luna, would like it. Good thing she's not our target audience – you, the voters, are, team. **So, you let us know if this plan sounds right to you.[But first, we have to ask – will you chip in $5 or more to make sure this plan reaches the halls of Congress →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53139860/374489682/386834152?refcode2=4de7009a-4152-ed11-819c-002248258e08&amount=5&refcode=221022_team_lynnvision_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzY4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGU3MDA5YS00MTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7tr5-Umf5jE7_MWFro4o9JbEKCAUtWJflYLGXrH2CQE=)** Okay, we'll keep this quick and to the point, but you can always find more information on our [website](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53139867/374489683/1587097497?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzY4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGU3MDA5YS00MTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7tr5-Umf5jE7_MWFro4o9JbEKCAUtWJflYLGXrH2CQE=&emci=8326eb64-7651-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=4de7009a-4152-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=1139417). Here's Eric's plan for the future:
* **Economic security for everyone:** In short, we need to create good-paying jobs, now. We need a $15 minimum wage, middle class tax cuts, an expansion of Social Security, and improved benefits and conditions for our workers.
* **Community security for our families:** Eric will start with common sense gun reform, protection of reproductive rights, and investment in a fair, inclusive education system.
* **National security for our country:** Eric served his country in the Pentagon as a national security advisor, and he knows what it takes to put national security first. In Congress, he will work to protect our troops, secure our border while treating immigrants with dignity and respect, and expand resources for our veterans who have fought for our freedom.
* **Global security for our future:** Our country does not exist in a vacuum, and we have to address the issues that are impacting our country and our world. Eric will fight for reforms to address climate change, revive American manufacturing, and fund technological research and development to solve current and future challenges.

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b6e00b6e78a44d7aa00ecbe518999a50&_e=gl2NV_a98VVtDaFeNX_6vuPe_2IcZ2gkOMvQrkOgwD0pSeNDThfnkA5P9meqz7wjQ2mvv7p6T2EKsL0pOthhw_fR5iab3KgrLDoR-v9iFCTqsdDDvF9vHJaMfCCgey4Pj6DXjvgYtaa07DeJsu9uRS4CFcahGvutqKXeWP6PcDFb2r-fi6xPA3_yRvfvj4fNYa9J84elMt-ggSifQX8yXrEixjtH8oxfB9hn5n-Fef5-V7jIpjefx6yaCVcwRVTtrIL-0PNl3HrN-tbhl-ZYdZx_zPFIS28gVzR4eg2HVHl6KojzS7y4aVnHhlkfOTwQha9hvAAGueMkdYhm0s_B_NJPKgaOOfjKr42vghwPUS_x7IETQgSta1d1k-ZRq9pnitK_jLoixYgC6HYHHLmFkA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b6e00b6e78a44d7aa00ecbe518999a50&_e=gl2NV_a98VVtDaFeNX_6vuPe_2IcZ2gkOMvQrkOgwD0pSeNDThfnkA5P9meqz7wjQ2mvv7p6T2EKsL0pOthhw_fR5iab3KgrLDoR-v9iFCTqsdDDvF9vHJaMfCCgey4Pj6DXjvgYtaa07DeJsu9uRS4CFcahGvutqKXeWP6PcDFb2r-fi6xPA3_yRvfvj4fNYa9J84elMt-ggSifQX8yXrEixjtH8oxfB9hn5n-Fef7j7D777IyD7yxpzMRvTNYGtE65sTozkZLCglZXcePYYmTisAwac94u3TS-XkG85-XHN5XSnJCTChpMvQ3BuQGwQ9hSB-uzlMfFgAFaCnxQ7kETTD4lCYLL95UZ-MV8nMsCictcTIIEMpOtrUu5Ks09ud0xcGrNAGW41dfpt1xrRQ%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b6e00b6e78a44d7aa00ecbe518999a50&_e=gl2NV_a98VVtDaFeNX_6vuPe_2IcZ2gkOMvQrkOgwD0pSeNDThfnkA5P9meqz7wjQ2mvv7p6T2EKsL0pOthhw_fR5iab3KgrLDoR-v9iFCTqsdDDvF9vHJaMfCCgey4Pj6DXjvgYtaa07DeJsu9uRS4CFcahGvutqKXeWP6PcDFb2r-fi6xPA3_yRvfvj4fNYa9J84elMt-ggSifQX8yXrEixjtH8oxfB9hn5n-Fef6bG5nGkiRsTVZZ60_PnPZ1loB3mXIrqD6zIuKdEMBQcXHIxBD59XIcIou8JeQC8qLU7ONa4VRI8rEdHHFuaLr8aS_ca3W_dvvHkZe77pzhBAr6la47RUnjxU2XV6GF7jOXipFT3IqFuaT3KcY5aFXFQnD_vNCuShwjzlmAw1jdWA%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

# Jocko Podcast 356: We Can Determine What Manner of Men We Will Be.
With Ed Thelander
| | Ed had a great discussion with fellow retired Navy SEAL Jocko Willink this week. The first part uncovers some great details about Ed’s life and journey as a Navy SEAL. It's like sitting in on a reunion between two SEAL buddies as they swap stories of their service. Then they get into a discussion about the campaign and the plight of the Maine lobster industry.

Jocko really does a great job pulling stories out of his guests! He owns a clothing manufacturing company in Maine, [ORIGIN MAINE](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=fcc511d750&e=f8a0a76a2b), and has a strong interest in our state.

body:
The Congressional Black Caucus PAC chooses WHITE DEM over Black Republican.. ARE YOU SERIOUS? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e7a3f05ec553/we-need-more-veterans-in-the-house-do-you-agree-15924025?e=3cd8121505)
---
| |
---
| |
#
**My Fellow Patriot,**
**Did you hear about what the RACIST Congressional Black Caucus PAC did? They chose a WHITE DEMOCRAT over a BLACK REPUBLICAN. Are they serious?! This caucus doesn't care about empowering Black candidates; they care about one thing, electing more Democrats.** **“The Congressional Black Caucus PAC is committed to electing African-Americans and African-American allies to Congress who will fight for our values...," wouldn't a conservative Black woman not be a good fighter for our shared values? What’s their excuse for excluding Black Republican Byron Donalds? ** **Instead of Blacks Only and White Only signs, we have Democrat Only signs. I’m BLACK, and I’m infuriated! These racist Democrats are swinging an election AWAY from a Black candidate to benefit their hyper-partisan candidate. I call it what it is, BS!** [**HELP SUPPORT BLACK CONSERVATIVES**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=8beaba3d9a&e=3cd8121505) **[Now, polling shows what we already know. The Left, which claims to serve the marginalized and minority communities, is the party culpable for the “serious financial problems” from inflation.](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=9af0699ebc&e=3cd8121505) ** [**HELP SUPPORT BLACK CANDIDATES!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=98a6d75269&e=3cd8121505)
**My name is Leon Benjamin, and I’m running for Congress as a Conservative Republican... because I’m sick of what the far Left has done to my community and to American families. I’m a husband, father, and pastor. I owe it to my congregation and my family to build a better future. These days we need to fight for them even to have a future!** [**Help me beat the special interests and the Soros money, and support our list of endorsed candidates- $50, $150, $250!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=5d3787334d&e=3cd8121505)
**I’m a Navy Combat Veteran, Small Business Owner, and Senior Pastor and Bishop at my church. I even helped create President Trump’s Faith-Based Initiative back in 2016.**

**I’m up against a proxy-voting DC sellout who sells out Christianity and the black community at every SECOND! My opponent VOTED FOR inflation! VOTED FOR the border crisis! VOTED FOR more crime! VOTED FOR election overhaul! Unlike him, I WILL SERVE MY COMMUNITY!**
[**SUPPORT BLACK CONSERVATIVE CANDIDATES!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=d917fce9f8&e=3cd8121505)
**If the Left really cared about the Black community, as President Trump does, then we would have seen greater action decades ago as we saw in the last administration. It’s time the Left learned that conservative principles and conservative values ARE BLACK VALUES.

BLM and Antifa are more focused on destroying our communities and burning them down than fighting issues affecting us like inflation, high gas prices, or higher consumer prices. They are hateful, destructive, and out of touch. ** [**DONATE TO TAKE BACK THE HOUSE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=b90f67c589&e=3cd8121505) **My opponent is a radical leftist who’s voted to strip law-abiding Americans, voted for the election overthrow HR-1, gun control, socialism, mass amnesty, and so much more. His actions to trample our constitution, destroy American values and suppress We The People’s voice is unacceptable.

I appreciate your support; my team said I need to come up with $15,000 by the end of this month to help secure our media and radio slots to win the general. **
[**DONATE NOW!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=ee884a663d&e=3cd8121505)
[**$25**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=148346e75f&e=3cd8121505) [**$50**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=dbbab7b002&e=3cd8121505)
**[$75](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=5ddf7e3012&e=3cd8121505)**
**[$100](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=8fdfa11b71&e=3cd8121505)**
**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=3d4a4700fc&e=3cd8121505)

body:
My team encouraged me to write to you.
#
Peter, I talked to my team this morning, and unfortunately they told me that after the federal fundraising deadline closed on Wednesday, we fell just shy of our goal.
We’re 17 days out from the election. To put it simply, we can’t afford to fall behind right now. But we can make it up, which is why I wanted to reach out personally and make a request.
**We have to pick up our fundraising, Peter – so after November 8th, I can continue to lead the fights for Medicare for All, abolishing the filibuster, protecting reproductive rights, and much more.**
As I said, right now we’re coming up short, but it’s not insurmountable. **If we raise the amount we need – or even more – it will guarantee we have the funds necessary for one of the most important elections of my entire lifetime.**
I’ll be honest, I am a little worried we won’t reach our goal, but I have faith in our grassroots movement. [**That’s why I’m hoping I can count on your support in this final countdown to the election. I’m asking you personally: will you chip in whatever you can today and give our campaign the boost we need?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20610?refcode=em20221022-1747&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1747%2E420207%2E1ihx7E)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20610?refcode=em20221022-1747&t=20&akid=1747%2E420207%2E1ihx7E)**

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey Abrams.

Our final public fundraising report deadline is in less than 72 hours.
That means in just 72 hours, our fundraising numbers will be locked in
then made public for the entire world to see.

So as I’m out on my Let’s Get It Done bus tour, I’ll be making
calls, Derek. Calls
to say thank you to grassroots supporters like you and to listen to
stories from people who donate to this campaign.

our numbers go public, you might get a call from me. Can you donate
$5 or any amount to ensure we can hit our $1 million goal,
turn out voters in the last days of the campaign and make sure you’re on
my call list?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=Sa_em_221022_B3_SYACall_S1_T1_SYA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=14616%2E1862389%2EtBmdtd ]DONATE

[ Stacey ]Stacey Abrams Give you a call

We only have 72 hours until our numbers lock in for the last time.

We only have 72 hours to show the world how much momentum we have behind
us.

We only have 72 hours to mobilize millions of voters across the state.

We can’t wait,
Derek. Brian Kemp is hoping we
fall short of our $1 million goal — because it would signal that
enthusiasm for our campaign is fading. We have to go into the final days
of the campaign in as strong a position as possible. We need a surge of
donations to get as many Georgians as possible through the door and into a
voting booth.

A better Georgia is possible. A safer Georgia is possible. One Georgia is
possible.

sense for your budget today? Any amount — no matter how big or small —
might give us a chance to talk over the phone. I would love the chance to
call and thank you very soon.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=Sa_em_221022_B3_SYACall_S1_T1_SYA_30Open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=14616%2E1862389%2EtBmdtd ]DONATE

Stacey

clean_body: Yes, I’m Black and a Republican. That REALLY bothers the Left. | Peter - MSNBC has called me every name in the book during this campaign. They've likened me to a slave doing the bidding of my white masters; they've called me a "token" Black Republican. After my debate with Senator Warnock, their hosts took to the airwaves to tear me down AGAIN. Joy Reid and Alex Wagner on Alex Wagner Tonight agreed with a college professor's editorial that I am just a "warm body that can be used as a pawn." Joy Reid further said I was only useful as a Black candidate because I'm "compliant" enough to vote the way Donald Trump and "White Republicans" tell me to. THIS IS RACIST AND DISGUSTING. I'm a proud Black man with conservative values. Because I don't fit the narrative of how the Left demands that I think and act, they declare me to be a"token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," "not part of the Black community," a "negro," a "white insult to black people," or a "house n*" (all of which I've been called recently). What's also disturbing is that my opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so. Unfortunately, Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing. I believe the loudest and clearest way to push back against these kinds of disgusting attacks is to defeat them at the ballot box. As I run for Senate, I ask people to vote for me if they think I'm the best candidate for the job - not because of my skin color. I'm tired of some people dividing Americans based on race. Peter,

As your congresswoman, my focus has always been on listening to and supporting the people of Washington's 8th District.

Since I was sworn into Congress, I've helped thousands of constituents across our district, held 97 town halls, and had 14 bills signed into law including legislation to lower prescription drug costs, improve forest roads and waterways, prevent Medicare cuts, and more.

**None of what we accomplished would be possible without grassroots support.**

We beat the odds by flipping Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020 – even with Republican dark money groups spending millions of dollars to defeat me.

I'm ready to keep fighting for every person in our district, but I have a tough battle of my own to fight first. The GOP is spending nearly $7 million to flip this seat red and elect an extreme Republican who will put loyalty to Donald Trump and Kevin McCarthy ahead of his own constituents.

body:
Every time I see one it motivates me to fight even harder. It’s a reminder of what is so broken about our politics
#

Every day, North Carolinians wake up to at least $450,000 of attack ads from Republican super PACs.
I knew I’d be bombarded with lies and smears, and I know it’s tough to take. Every time I see one it motivates me to fight even harder. It’s a reminder of what is so broken about our politics, and why we so desperately need new leadership in Washington — not another insider like my opponent Ted Budd.
Now look, I’m not going to let the attacks go unanswered. You deserve a Senator who isn’t afraid to go toe to toe with corporate special interests to stand up for truth and justice, and we are proving every day that we know how to fight hard. It’s why this race is still deadlocked — despite all this outside spending.
But now is not a moment where we can afford to slow down. I know you probably didn’t expect to make a donation to our campaign when you woke up today, but we really need your support if we want to flip this Senate seat.

subject: Have a couple minutes, Derek? I want to tell you about Josh Riley, who was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and a great civil rights champion. Now he’s running for one of the most competitive House seats in the country.
body:
Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email,
I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.)
I want you to give to Josh Riley’s campaign for the open House in seat in NY’s 19th district. And to CommonGood too. Please donate now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221022_CGVA_Riley]
Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some.
Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY.
After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed.
Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about.
Josh is the hardest worker I know.
Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.
We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend.
And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation.
Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221022_CGVA_Riley]

Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.
This is important. To me. And to our nation.
Thanks,
Al

body:

Peter ? this is bad ? really bad. We've just received word that a major right-wing Super PAC has dropped $5 million into the Arizona Senate race, where Senator Mark Kelly is up against venture capital executive Blake Masters.

Mark Kelly is an environmental champion who just helped secure the most significant climate investment in history. Blake Masters is a climate change denier who's backed by white supremacists.

This move follows a poll that puts the race within two points. Masters' political backers see a window to swing this Senate race, and they've jumped on it. What's more: the same Super PAC has spent millions on the Senate race in Georgia for Herschel Walker to defeat Senator Raphael Warnock.

Peter: Bottom line, we need your help. Environmental field operations are still underfunded, and a group of donors has put together an emergency match fund to triple every contribution. We have to move now or we could lose these races.

Your support is needed to secure important wins from climate candidates in November. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT when you make a gift of any amount ? even $5 makes a difference >>> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ypTVq__

We have a goal to knock on 161,875 doors in Arizona, and a total of 1.17 million doors in critical swing states including Nevada, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. And we have digital ads running in support of dozens of pro-environmental candidates, which we'll continue leading up to the election.

Study after study shows that speaking with voters through field organizing is the best way to connect with voters about where candidates stand on critical issues ? and get them to turn out on Election Day.

We're scaling up on-the-ground canvassing operations, getting folks to sign commit-to-vote cards, and helping them sign up to vote by mail. And we're encouraging voters to commit to reminding three friends or family members to vote, a tactic called "Vote Tripling."

We're looking for fellow environmentalists like you, Peter, to help us continue our canvassing efforts and get pro-climate candidates elected in November. Can you chip in?

Every single vote counts. Please, pitch in ? ANY amount can really make a difference right now, even if it's just $5. This could be the difference between ensuring an environmental majority or setting us back indefinitely >> https://links.messages.lcv.

Help defeat Blake Masters and the other Big Oil candidates running this election cycle. Our future depends on it.

Onward,

Hey there, it’s Patrick. I know your inbox is probably slammed, but with only 17 days left until Election Day, I promise this is one of the last emails you’ll receive from me! **With election day quickly approaching on November 8, so is our FINAL campaign finance filing deadline. We have until _tomorrow at 11:59 PM_ to reach our goal. Everything we raise up until then will go public.** The bad news is that our fundraising has _really_ slowed down this week. name: Herschel Walker
subject: According to MSNBC, I’m just a “WARM BODY”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
Yes, I’m Black and a Republican. That REALLY bothers the Left. |
---

Fellow American - MSNBC has called me every name in the book during this campaign.

**They've likened me to a slave doing the bidding of my white masters; they've called me a "token" Black Republican.**

After my debate with Senator Warnock, their hosts took to the airwaves to tear me down AGAIN.

**Joy Reid and Alex Wagner on _Alex Wagner Tonight_ agreed with a college professor's editorial that I am just a "warm body that can be used as a pawn." Joy Reid further said I was only useful as a Black candidate because I'm "compliant" enough to vote the way Donald Trump and "White Republicans" tell me to.**

**THIS IS RACIST AND DISGUSTING.**

_I'm a proud Black man with conservative values. Because I don't fit the narrative of how the Left demands that I think and act, they declare me to be a**"token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," "not part of the Black community,"** a **"negro,"** a **"white insult to black people,"** or a **"house n*****"** (all of which I've been called recently)._

Most of the headlines on the midterm elections are about Congress. But we’ve also got dozens of governor’s races across the country — and they are powerfully important. Governors can make the difference between people getting health care or having to skip doctor’s appointments. Governors can determine whether kids are going into well-funded classrooms with well-supported teachers. And now that the Supreme Court has left abortion policy up to the states, governors can be the last line of defense for the right to an abortion. **So today, I want to call attention to four terrific Democratic candidates for governor: Stacey Abrams in Georgia, Tony Evers in Wisconsin, Tina Kotek in Oregon, and Josh Shapiro in Pennsylvania. >
Let’s talk about why I’ve got my eye on these races in particular.
**Stacey Abrams** needs no introduction. From fighting for voting rights to paying down medical debt for Georgians, she’s already delivered victories for working people. She fought hard and won to flip two U.S. Senate seats and take back control in 2020 and 2021. And she’s got plans to make sure every Georgian can thrive.
But she’s in a tough rematch against Republican Governor Brian Kemp, who’s restricted the freedom to vote, refused to expand Medicaid, and signed one of the nation’s harshest abortion bans into law. We’ve got to send him packing.
**Tony Evers** is running for re-election in one of the closest swing states in the country. He’s a former public school teacher who’s increased funding for education, fought to overturn an abortion ban that dates back to 1849, and held the line against a gerrymandered, Republican-dominated state legislature.
Meanwhile, his opponent has promised to disband the state’s bipartisan Elections Commission ahead of 2024, called people “lazy” for getting stimulus checks and unemployment benefits in the pandemic, and said Donald Trump didn’t “do anything wrong” on January 6.
**Tina Kotek** , a former Speaker of the Oregon House of Representatives, has gotten big things done for working families, like raising the minimum wage, expanding health care coverage to all Oregonians, and passing landmark laws to make sure Oregonians have paid sick leave and paid family leave.
But she’s in an unusual three-way race, and a spoiler candidate could power the Republican nominee to victory. The polls are tight. If we don’t get Tina across the finish line, Oregon could have a GOP governor who opposes gun safety measures and said she “looks forward to the day” abortion rights are restricted.
As Pennsylvania’s attorney general, **Josh Shapiro** defended the results of the 2020 election all the way up to the Supreme Court. And abortion is only legal in Pennsylvania right now because the current Democratic governor can veto the Republican legislature’s anti-choice bills — so we’ve got to keep it that way.
And we can’t let Josh’s Republican opponent, Doug Mastriano, get anywhere near the governor’s mansion. Doug spread lies about the 2020 election, paid to bus Pennsylvanians to Donald Trump’s rally on January 6, was at the U.S. Capitol that day, and would have the power as governor to appoint Pennsylvania’s top elections official. We’ve got to stop him.
**Let’s make sure Stacey, Tony, Tina, and Josh have all the resources they need to win.**

Elizabeth

clean_body: I’ll just be blunt: We’ve got to win these races. | | | Most of the headlines on the midterm elections are about Congress. But we’ve also got dozens of governor’s races across the country — and they are powerfully important. Governors can make the difference between people getting health care or having to skip doctor’s appointments. Governors can determine whether kids are going into well-funded classrooms with well-supported teachers. And now that the Supreme Court has left abortion policy up to the states, governors can be the last line of defense for the right to an abortion. So today, I want to call attention to four terrific Democratic candidates for governor: Stacey Abrams in Georgia, Tony Evers in Wisconsin, Tina Kotek in Oregon, and Josh Shapiro in Pennsylvania. And with just over two weeks until Election Day, I’m asking if you can pitch in to support their campaigns. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Let’s talk about why I’ve got my eye on these races in particular. Stacey Abrams needs no introduction. From fighting for voting rights to paying down medical debt for Georgians, she’s already delivered victories for working people. She fought hard and won to flip two U.S. Senate seats and take back control in 2020 and 2021. And she’s got plans to make sure every Georgian can thrive. But she’s in a tough rematch against Republican Governor Brian Kemp, who’s restricted the freedom to vote, refused to expand Medicaid, and signed one of the nation’s harshest abortion bans into law. We’ve got to send him packing. Tony Evers is running for re-election in one of the closest swing states in the country. He’s a former public school teacher who’s increased funding for education, fought to overturn an abortion ban that dates back to 1849, and held the line against a gerrymandered, Republican-dominated state legislature. Meanwhile, his opponent has promised to disband the state’s bipartisan Elections Commission ahead of 2024, called people “lazy” for getting stimulus checks and unemployment benefits in the pandemic, and said Donald Trump didn’t “do anything wrong” on January 6. Tina Kotek , a former Speaker of the Oregon House of Representatives, has gotten big things done for working families, like raising the minimum wage, expanding health care coverage to all Oregonians, and passing landmark laws to make sure Oregonians have paid sick leave and paid family leave. But she’s in an unusual three-way race, and a spoiler candidate could power the Republican nominee to victory. The polls are tight. If we don’t get Tina across the finish line, Oregon could have a GOP governor who opposes gun safety measures and said she “looks forward to the day” abortion rights are restricted. As Pennsylvania’s attorney general, Josh Shapiro defended the results of the 2020 election all the way up to the Supreme Court. And abortion is only legal in Pennsylvania right now because the current Democratic governor can veto the Republican legislature’s anti-choice bills — so we’ve got to keep it that way. And we can’t let Josh’s Republican opponent, Doug Mastriano, get anywhere near the governor’s mansion. Doug spread lies about the 2020 election, paid to bus Pennsylvanians to Donald Trump’s rally on January 6, was at the U.S. Capitol that day, and would have the power as governor to appoint Pennsylvania’s top elections official. We’ve got to stop him. Let’s make sure Stacey, Tony, Tina, and Josh have all the resources they need to win. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

body:
The power of this team is enormous — and I know that with you on my side, we can get this done

Derek — I know you’ve been getting a lot of messages asking you to support this campaign or that campaign, so I want to make it clear what your investment is going towards. Here’s what we need resources for to cross the finish line in this race:
1. Knock every swing voter’s door to tell them about our campaign
2. Spread our message online and in-person across Pennsylvania
3. Recruit volunteers for text banks
4. Stop Mastriano from growing his base with last-minute spending
5. Keep our TV ads on the air

name: Charles Booker
subject: This is who I am
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker. Here’s what you should know about me:

I’m a lifelong resident of Louisville’s West End, growing up in what has
been one of the poorest zip codes in Kentucky.

Growing up, I experienced the pain of poverty firsthand and saw my mom
skip meals just so I could have enough. I’ve been homeless, and have had
to ration my insulin because I couldn’t afford the medication I needed as
a Type 1 diabetic.

I became the first in my family to graduate from law school and went on to
lead a transformative career across Kentucky, covering every level of
government. I’ve served as a Director of Fish and Wildlife, where I
traveled across the commonwealth and saw that all Kentuckians are united
in their hopes for a better future.

In 2018, I was elected to the Kentucky House of Representatives, becoming
the youngest Black state legislator in nearly 90 years.

As a legislator, I’ve fought for the people: common sense gun safety
reform, lower prescription drug prices, expanded voting rights, stronger
labor unions, and for racial justice. I’m a lifelong advocate for local
businesses and working people.

Two years ago, I founded Hood to the Holler, a grassroots organization to
build on the values that have animated my whole life and break down
barriers between Kentuckians and their government.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18780?t=1001&akid=2644%2E346206%2EGJjRDT ]Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to continue the work of making
Kentucky a place where all of us can thrive. Will you help me win by
donating $20 or more to my campaign?

CHIP IN →

Our campaign for a better Kentucky is built by grassroots supporters like
you. I can’t thank you enough for being in the fight with me.

Charles Booker

My opponent has increased his advertising spend on Facebook, and we need your help to raise the funds to match it.

_Why does this matter?_

My fake “independent” opponent has been planted in this race by Democrats, and now he’s knocked Utah out of being rated as a “Safe GOP” seat.

President Obama just called us all to action, noting that in New Hampshire, in this election, **“the future of our country really is on the ballot.”**

And folks, I really couldn’t have said it better myself.
In more ways than one, our country’s future is at stake this November. That’s true across the country, **but by winning here in New Hampshire, we have the opportunity to make a real difference in what that future looks like. **
**[Making that impact starts with defeating Don Bolduc, and this team’s ability to do that depends on what you choose to do today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53141503/374498334/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1900-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzRlNDQ0Zi00ODUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw3vDyVoecn6da2ujJnR98AZSxphNARSquNGDbvq_Io=)**
Let me explain – my opponent, Don Bolduc, and I could not be more different:

While I have always fought for a woman’s fundamental right to choose, he said that we should “rejoice” at the Supreme Court decision that ended _Roe v. Wade_ _._
While I have worked to make our democracy stronger, he has undermined its very foundations – spreading the Big Lie and even promising to overturn the results of the 2024 election should he be “called upon” to do so.
Don Bolduc is the most extreme nominee this state has seen in decades, and with him on the ballot, President Obama’s words have never been more true. Our future is at stake in this race. **[And with 17 days to lend your support to this campaign – be it $3 or $10 – it is still up to all of us to decide what that future looks like.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53141504/374498335/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1900-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzRlNDQ0Zi00ODUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw3vDyVoecn6da2ujJnR98AZSxphNARSquNGDbvq_Io=)**
We do not have to let Don Bolduc’s vision for this country – one where our daughters have fewer rights than their mothers and grandmothers, and where the will of the voters is not a sacred covenant, but something to be ignored – come to pass. I know that if we all stand together, we can beat him.
**[But it truly will take all of us, and we need to act today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53141505/374498336/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1900-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzRlNDQ0Zi00ODUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw3vDyVoecn6da2ujJnR98AZSxphNARSquNGDbvq_Io=)**

subject: The values I’m bringing with me to the U.S. Senate:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
We have a real chance to flip this seat next month, but we need to keep up our grassroots momentum and send Ron Johnson packing. | |
---
I’m a proud product of a union household. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift on the assembly line. It was their good-paying union jobs that gave me a fair shot at achieving the American Dream. I hadn’t given much thought to getting involved in politics until I saw Barack Obama’s 2004 DNC speech. It was then that I realized I, too, had the power to change things in my community. And throughout my years as an organizer, state representative, lieutenant governor, and now as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, I’ve never stopped fighting to give working people a seat at the table. But I’ve never done anything alone. It’s thanks to the faith and support that my parents, my community, and grassroots folks just like you have had in me. Now, I have to ask you to keep your faith. We have a real chance to flip this seat next month, but we need to keep up our grassroots momentum to send Ron Johnson packing. **Will you please make a $10 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and to the DNC? Every contribution (no matter the size) will ensure we can defeat Ron Johnson, expand our majority by winning nationwide, and deliver for Wisconsin families.**

subject: I am personally asking you to contribute to Governor Tony Evers' re-election campaign in Wisconsin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
I won’t mince words,
Derek.

Our democracy is under attack, and its fate will be determined in the 2022
elections — which is why I’m doing everything I can to help re-elect
Governor Tony Evers in Wisconsin.

Tony has served as a critical firewall to the anti-democracy agenda being
waged by too many in the Republican Party who have methodically and
intentionally undermined democracy in Wisconsin — using some of the worst
gerrymandering in the country to consolidate their power and lock in
near-permanent majorities in the state legislature.

We ended their trifecta in 2018 by defeating Scott Walker and electing
Tony Evers, who has been the last line of defense for democracy and voting
rights in Wisconsin ever since. It’s essential that we push with
everything we have, and nothing less, to help ensure he gets a second
term.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1733?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20221022_3_3&t=1001&akid=5536%2E1827488%2ET87_7t ]Derek, I am
personally asking you to do something important to help ensure Tony Evers
is re-elected in November. Will you consider contributing
$10 to Tony’s campaign today? Anything you can give will
help him defeat Trump-backed Tim Michels and continue defending democracy
in Wisconsin.

Tony has vetoed over a dozen bills passed by the Republican-controlled
legislature that would’ve made it harder for Wisconsinites to vote. He’s
done everything in his power to fight for fair maps, and I know we can
continue to count on him to stand firm against any attempts to undermine
free, fair, and secure elections.

This November, there will be Republican candidates on the ballot who
perpetuate the Big Lie and who view themselves as beholden to the extremes
of their party instead of our Constitution and the will of the people. One
of those candidates is Tony’s radical opponent, Tim Michels.

If Tim Michels were to win this seat, he will undoubtedly make it more
difficult for eligible voters to participate in our elections, and he will
work to undermine our electoral system.

That is what Tony is up against this fall. With so much on the line in
Wisconsin, we cannot afford to take our foot off the gas. Not for a
moment.

The citizens of Wisconsin deserve a leader who will fight to end
gerrymandering, protect the right to vote, and strengthen our democracy.
When they re-elect Tony Evers, that’s exactly what they will get. But Tony
is going to need all of us.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1733?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20221022_3_3&t=1002&akid=5536%2E1827488%2ET87_7t ]Will you donate $10 to Tony Evers' re-election campaign
for governor to help us defend democracy in Wisconsin? Democracy is on the
ballot this November. I’m asking you to help us fight for it.

As daunting as the challenges before us may seem, they are not
insurmountable — but only if people like you are willing to get involved
by standing with Tony.

Thank you,

Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General of the United States
Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee

Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
